## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-290-01` — A clean Xcode build launches the real app, exposes the menu item and redesigned popover, creates the complete CONTRACT-250 bundle through the actual menu action from a populated EvidenceStore, verifies every declared role and hash, and serves a read-only MCP query from its bundled helper.
- `AC-290-02` — Representative capacity, growth, active, paused, degraded, no-baseline, and error states pass visual, accessibility, and interaction inspection in light and dark appearance.
- `AC-290-03` — All inherited Swift tests and privacy, fallback, retention, export, and MCP scenarios pass with no newly introduced destructive or network surface.
- `AC-290-04` — The fresh-install Agent Access default is off; enabling permits read-only MCP, disabling promptly refuses it, and both transitions leave monitoring and evidence intact.
- `AC-290-05` — Time-tier boundaries, snapshot downsampling, finite anomaly detail, pressure eviction, coverage-loss reporting, lifecycle UI, manual export ownership, and get_evidence_lifecycle compose without exceeding the configured database limit; capped roots expose durable multi-slice progress and eventually close their entry-cap gap.
- `AC-290-06` — The complete evidence-chain matrix passes: multi-slice full-root convergence, A/B/C complete deletion versus partial uncertainty, restart gap, scope change, rename, replace, path reuse, current-only cleanup candidates, ended-session impact, ordered provenance, filter-before-limit pagination, and current-state survival through compaction.
- `AC-290-07` — The launched settings flow adds a non-default watched folder without using or crashing the open/save panel service, persists it once, and a completed Export Current Evidence action opens the exported evidence directory itself in Finder.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-290-01` (increment-audit) — Build and launch transcript, app-bundle inspection, UI screenshots and accessibility notes, a retained actual menu-produced bundle from populated state, its integrity verification and usefulness checklist, multi-slice convergence results, MCP parity, full regression output, and changed-surface inspection.
